budget_note: plan.md P4 studio kit total 80k, split across 5 as 24000 shelves, 16000 desk lamp, 8000 mug, 20000 drawing tubes, 12000 pinned drawings
lynx_commit_note: stamped by the writer: the newest commit touching this folder when the manifest was written

input.note: B kept: plain grey ground, round holder, five tubes with two rolls. A fails: saturated blue ground, not plain grey, and a strapped holder with rivets. Built procedurally instead of through TRELLIS (GPU held by the mage-arena run); concept.png is the shape reference.

mesh_acceptance.note: re-imported from final.glb: 1 mesh object, 5144 vertices, 10220 tris, 17 connected components, 0 floaters (a floater is a component whose bounding box touches no other), 0 open edges, signed volume 0.002405 m3 (positive: normals face out)

scale.note: 16.25 x 17.48 x 51.82 cm (x, y, z up) re-imported from final.glb, inside the planned envelope (a 14 cm round holder 20 cm tall, five 4 cm tubes and two rolled drawings leaning out of it, about 50 cm overall); pivot: base centre 0, 0 m, floor at z = 0 m. Assumption: the sizes are Lynx choices from the concept; the UE world scale is still to be confirmed on Wolf.

finishing.note: finish: 1408 bevelled hard edges, custom (hardened) normals true, 79% of faces smooth-shaded, baked atlas at 1223.6 px/m from 2 CC0 scans; one UV set (1); 3 PBR PNGs (base colour, normal, ORM for 1 slots); every file under 10 MB (largest 3137900 bytes); 1 material slots (drawing_tubes_atlas); evidence turnaround.jpg and table-view.jpg rendered with Cycles on the CPU (in-context EEVEE renders: scripts/art/studio-kit/render_context.bpy), framing check passes on 5 images (min silhouette margin 0.0854 of the image, rule 0.03). Not claimed: any UE import.

pivot: base centre (x and y at the middle of the footprint, z = 0 at the floor); measured 0, 0 m; the prop stands +Y in the GLB (glTF Y-up), +Z in Blender
scale_reasoning: a 14 cm round holder 20 cm tall, five 4 cm tubes and two rolled drawings leaning out of it, about 50 cm overall. Measured 16.25 x 51.82 x 17.48 cm (x, up, y); the planned envelope per axis is 15-30 cm, 15-30 cm, 42-60 cm (x, y, z up).
textures: 3 PNGs: one 1024 px atlas (drawing_tubes_atlas_basecolor, _orm with R occlusion, G roughness, B metal, and a tangent-space OpenGL _normal), baked with Cycles on the CPU in scripts/art/studio-kit/build_studio.bpy from layered bake-source materials (scripts/art/lib/finish.bpy): Poly Haven CC0 scans tinted to the palette, curvature edge wear, room-scale grunge, AO (also multiplied into basecolor at 0.55, as the forward-shaded UE scene has no runtime AO). One unique UV set: smart projection, islands at one texel density, hidden faces (book sides inside a row, undersides) shrunk to 0.12, 1223.6 px/m on the visible surface (0.285 m2 visible, 57% of the surface hidden). Bake seconds: {"base":4.36,"rough":2.34,"metal":1.48,"normal":2.41,"ao":7.38}. GLB embeds the atlas as PNG.

finish.bevel: angle-limited (30 degrees) bevel on every primitive's hard edges, width per part (0.5 to 3 mm), 2 segments, arc miter, clamped, hardened normals, then a weighted normal (face area, keep sharp) and smooth shading; 1408 hard edges bevelled, 620 kept sharp by design (paper edges, spiral roll ends, small screws), 0 convex edges of 60 degrees or more left unrounded (inside other parts or at acute corners)

blender: Blender 5.2.2, scripts/art/studio-kit/build_studio.bpy (build and score), render_studio.bpy (evidence and framing check), write_manifest.mjs
